title: Longest Well-Performing Interval
description: Find the length of the longest well-performing interval in an array where hours > 8 are points (1) and others are (-1).
pseudocode:
1. score = 0, maxLen = 0, map = {0: -1}
2. for i, val in enumerate(hours):
3.   score += 1 if val > 8 else -1
4.   if score > 0: maxLen = i + 1
5.   else:
6.     if score - 1 in map: maxLen = max(maxLen, i - map[score - 1])
7.     if score not in map: map[score] = i

steps.note: Initialize score and map to track first occurrences of prefix sums.
Score 0 already in map, keep initial index -1.
